name: Tooltip
description: Explains an element on pointer hover or keyboard focus.

attributes.name: open
attributes.description: Controls whether the tooltip is open.

slots.name: icon
slots.description: An icon shown by large tooltips.

events.name: noora-open-change
events.description: Emitted when the tooltip opens or closes.

examples.title: Default
examples.description: Explain an icon or compact action.

examples.title: Large
examples.description: Add an icon and supporting description.
examples.markup: <noora-tooltip size="large" title="Tooltip" description="Insert tooltip description here. Three lines of text would look better."><noora-icon slot="trigger" name="alert_circle" label="More information"></noora-icon><noora-icon slot="icon" name="category"></noora-icon></noora-tooltip>
